Household.title: Household
Household.description: Represents a family household identified by a unique Family Code AX-XXX-####

code.description: Unique Family Code formatted as AX-[3 letters]-[4 digits]

name.description: Household display name, e.g. The Taylor Family

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator

HouseholdMember.title: HouseholdMember
HouseholdMember.description: A profile member inside a household with safe non-PII details (role and optional nickname only)

nickname.description: Optional friendly nickname without full name

avatarColor.description: Theme color code for the member avatar badge

MemberResponse.title: MemberResponse
MemberResponse.description: Stores each person's responses separately under the household (empty in stage 1)

answers.description: Stored member survey answers and preferences, initialized empty in stage 1

UserSession.title: UserSession
UserSession.description: Tracks the active household and selected member for an anonymous user device

userId.description: Auth UID of the device user

/households/{householdId}.description: Stores household document with ID equal to the unique Family Code (e.g. AX-PAN-4827)

/households/{householdId}/members/{membe.description: Subcollection of members within a household

/households/{householdId}/responses/{mem.description: Subcollection of response documents per member under the household

/userSessions/{userId}.description: Stores active device session and profile selection per anonymous user UID
